set_aside.subject: Initial value and lifecycle of the email-verified mark
set_aside.text: A staff account keeps a recorded "email verified" mark: the administrator's activation, the first administrator's creation (R0-07) and the recovery override (R0-20) set it
set_aside.question: What value does the mark have when an administrator creates a pending staff account, and can any later status transition clear it?
options: A pending account starts with the mark false, and no operation ever clears it
A pending account starts with an unset/null mark, which activation changes to true
Status transitions such as suspension, disabling, or returning to pending clear the mark
set_aside.default_guess: Store false on ordinary account creation, change it to true on activation, and never clear it.

witness.initial: An active administrator exists and no account exists for worker@example.com.
events: The administrator creates worker@example.com as pending_verification.
The administrator reads the new account before activating it.
outcomes: The account view reports email_verified=null or another unset state.
witness.observer: The administrator consuming the account view

set_aside.subject: Account view that exposes the email-verified mark
set_aside.question: Which operation is the account view, which principals may read it, and what observable field or representation carries the mark?
options: Only an administrator-facing staff-account view exposes a boolean field
Both the holder's own account view and administrator views expose it
set_aside.default_guess: Expose a boolean email_verified field in administrator staff-account reads and in the holder's own account read, but not in unrelated responses.

witness.initial: A staff account has been activated, so its recorded mark is set.
events: The holder signs in and requests the portal's available account representation.
An administrator requests the same staff account through staff administration.
outcomes: Only the administrator response contains the mark.
witness.observer: The staff holder and the administrator, or clients implementing those API calls

set_aside.subject: Activation status and email-verified mark update
set_aside.question: Must changing pending_verification to active and setting the email-verified mark commit atomically, and what state and failure are observable if storage fails during that action?
options: Both changes commit atomically or neither does
The status may become active even if setting the mark fails
The mark may be set even if changing the status fails
set_aside.default_guess: Make activation transactional: on any failure the account remains pending with its previous mark, and the operation reports failure.

witness.initial: A staff account is pending_verification and its email-verified mark is not set.
events: Storage fails after one of the two required facts could have been written.
The holder attempts to sign in and the administrator reads the account.
outcomes: The transaction rolls back: the account remains pending and sign-in is refused.
A partial write remains: the account is active and can sign in while its mark is unset, or its mark is set while it remains pending.
witness.observer: The staff holder and the administrator
